class.name: gripperx_swerve_controller/SwerveController
class.description: 4WIS4WID swerve kinematics as a ros2_control controller (NFR-10, §3.1 variant B). Subscribes /cmd_vel, owns arbitration point A2 (/teleop/direct_steer override), enforces the per-wheel per-direction steering window (FR-5/SR-6) and writes the four steering position and four wheel velocity command interfaces. Open-loop on wheel velocity (FR-11).
